## VIX (Volatility Index) term structure

The data is downloaded from the [Taiwan Futures Exchange](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/3/dlOptDailyMarketView). VIX for each expiration date is calculated, and a daily static term-structure chart is published. The methodology is based on Cboe VIX, see [Cboe Volatility Index Mathematics Methodology](https://cdn.cboe.com/resources/indices/Cboe_Volatility_Index_Mathematics_Methodology.pdf).

```{=html}
<div class="project-card vix-interactive-card">
  <p id="vix-status">Loading VIX term-structure history…</p>

  <div id="vix-term-chart"></div>

  <div class="vix-slider-wrap">
    <input
      id="vix-date-slider"
      type="range"
      min="0"
      max="0"
      step="1"
      value="0"
      disabled
      aria-label="Select VIX term structure trading date"
    >

    <div class="vix-slider-labels">
      <span id="vix-start-date"></span>
      <strong id="vix-selected-date"></strong>
      <span id="vix-end-date"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="observatory-subsection">
    <p id="vix-volume-status">Loading TXO option volume…</p>

    <div
      id="vix-volume-chart"
    ></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Front-expiry VIX vs TAIEX

The nearest-expiry VIX is shown against the TAIEX close over the latest month, illustrating how short-dated implied volatility moves with the index.

```{=html}
<div class="project-card">
  <p id="front-vix-taiex-status">
    Loading TAIEX and nearest-expiry VIX history…
  </p>

  <div
    id="front-vix-taiex-chart"
  ></div>
</div>
```

## IV (Implied Volatility) Curves

IV is calculated by numerically inverting the Black formula for each eligible OTM option quote. The workflow uses settlement prices, requires exact option–futures expiration matching, and performs no nearest-contract substitution or IV smoothing.

Move the cursor over a point to inspect its strike, IV and option price. Drag to zoom; double-click a chart or use Reset zoom to restore its view.

### TAIEX Futures (TXF) IV curve

Only TXF futures contracts with matching expiration dates are included. The chart updates daily, displaying up to four nearest expiration dates.

```{=html}
<div class="project-card txo-iv-card">
  <div class="txo-iv-toolbar">
    <p id="tx-status" role="status">Loading the latest TX curve…</p>
    <button id="tx-iv-reset" class="txo-iv-reset" type="button" disabled>Reset zoom</button>
  </div>
  <div id="tx-chart" class="txo-iv-grid" aria-busy="true"></div>
</div>
```

### Mini-TAIEX Futures (MXF) IV curve

Only MXF futures contracts with matching expiration dates are included. The chart updates daily, displaying up to four nearest expiration dates.

```{=html}
<div class="project-card txo-iv-card">
  <div class="txo-iv-toolbar">
    <p id="mtx-status" role="status">Loading the latest MXF curve…</p>
    <button id="mtx-iv-reset" class="txo-iv-reset" type="button" disabled>Reset zoom</button>
  </div>
  <div id="mtx-chart" class="txo-iv-grid" aria-busy="true"></div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const plotlyReady = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const script = document.createElement("script");
    script.src = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/plotly.js-basic-dist-min@4.1.1/plotly-basic.min.js";
    script.async = true;
    script.onload = resolve;
    script.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Plotly could not be loaded"));
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  });

  const user = "siang-dai";
  const repo = "txo-vix-iv";

  const rawRoot =
    `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${user}/${repo}/main`;

  const rawOutput = `${rawRoot}/output`;
  const rawData = `${rawRoot}/data`;

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // VIX interactive term structure + option volume
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  const chart =
    document.getElementById("vix-term-chart");

  const status =
    document.getElementById("vix-status");

  const slider =
    document.getElementById("vix-date-slider");

  const startLabel =
    document.getElementById("vix-start-date");

  const selectedLabel =
    document.getElementById("vix-selected-date");

  const endLabel =
    document.getElementById("vix-end-date");

  const volumeChart =
    document.getElementById("vix-volume-chart");

  const volumeStatus =
    document.getElementById("vix-volume-status");

  function parseCsv(text) {
    const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    const headers = lines[0].split(",");

    return lines
      .slice(1)
      .map(line => {
        const values = line.split(",");

        const row = Object.fromEntries(
          headers.map((header, i) => [
            header.trim(),
            values[i] ?? ""
          ])
        );

        return {
          Date: String(row.Date || "").trim(),
          Expiration_Month: String(row.Expiration_Month || "").trim(),
          Expiration_Date: String(row.Expiration_Date || "").trim(),
          Days_to_Exp: Number(row.Days_to_Exp),
          Forward: Number(row.Forward),
          VIX: Number(row.VIX)
        };
      })
      .filter(row =>
        row.Date &&
        Number.isFinite(row.Days_to_Exp) &&
        Number.isFinite(row.VIX)
      );
  }

  function parseVolumeCsv(text) {
    if (!text || !text.trim()) {
      return [];
    }

    const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    const headers = lines[0].split(",");

    return lines
      .slice(1)
      .map(line => {
        const values = line.split(",");

        const row = Object.fromEntries(
          headers.map((header, i) => [
            header.trim(),
            values[i] ?? ""
          ])
        );

        return {
          Date: String(row.Date || "").trim(),
          Expiration_Month: String(row.Expiration_Month || "").trim(),
          Volume: Number(row.Volume)
        };
      })
      .filter(row =>
        row.Date &&
        row.Expiration_Month &&
        Number.isFinite(row.Volume)
      );
  }

  function isoDate(value) {
    return new Date(`${value}T00:00:00Z`);
  }

  function renderTermStructure(rows, date) {
    const daily = rows
      .filter(row => row.Date === date)
      .sort((a, b) => a.Days_to_Exp - b.Days_to_Exp);

    const bodyColor =
      getComputedStyle(document.body).color;

    const trace = {
      type: "scatter",
      mode: "lines+markers",
      x: daily.map(row => row.Days_to_Exp),
      y: daily.map(row => row.VIX),
      text: daily.map(row => row.Expiration_Month),
      customdata: daily.map(row => [
        row.Expiration_Date,
        row.Forward
      ]),
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>%{text}</b>" +
        "<br>Expiration: %{customdata[0]}" +
        "<br>Days to expiration: %{x:.0f}" +
        "<br>VIX: %{y:.2f}%" +
        "<br>Implied forward: %{customdata[1]:,.2f}" +
        "<extra></extra>",
      line: {
        width: 2.4
      },
      marker: {
        size: 8
      }
    };

    const layout = {
      title: {
        text: `TXO VIX Term Structure — ${date}`,
        x: 0.5
      },
      xaxis: {
        title: "Days to expiration",
        rangemode: "tozero",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.22)"
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: "Annualized implied volatility (%)",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.22)"
      },
      margin: {
        l: 70,
        r: 25,
        t: 70,
        b: 65
      },
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font: {
        color: bodyColor
      },
      hovermode: "closest",
      showlegend: false,
      autosize: true
    };

    ObservatoryCharts.react(
      chart,
      [trace],
      layout,
      {
        responsive: true,
        displaylogo: false,
        scrollZoom: false
      }
    );

    selectedLabel.textContent = date;

    status.textContent =
      `Trading date: ${date} · ` +
      `${daily.length} expirations · ` +
      `move the slider to inspect the last 30 calendar days.`;
  }

  function renderVolume(volumeRows, date) {
    const daily = volumeRows
      .filter(row => row.Date === date)
      .sort((a, b) =>
        String(a.Expiration_Month).localeCompare(
          String(b.Expiration_Month)
        )
      );

    if (!daily.length) {
      Plotly.purge(volumeChart);

      volumeStatus.textContent =
        `No option-volume data available for ${date}.`;

      return;
    }

    const bodyColor =
      getComputedStyle(document.body).color;

    const trace = {
      type: "bar",
      x: daily.map(row => row.Expiration_Month),
      y: daily.map(row => row.Volume),
      customdata: daily.map(() => date),
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>%{x}</b>" +
        "<br>Trading date: %{customdata}" +
        "<br>Call + Put volume: %{y:,.0f}" +
        "<extra></extra>"
    };

    const layout = {
      title: {
        text: `TXO Option Volume by Expiration — ${date}`,
        x: 0.5,
        font: {
          size: 18
        }
      },
      xaxis: {
        title: "Expiration",
        type: "category",
        automargin: true
      },
      yaxis: {
        title: "Call + Put volume",
        rangemode: "tozero",
        tickformat: ",",
        gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.18)",
        automargin: true
      },
      margin: {
        l: 80,
        r: 30,
        t: 60,
        b: 75
      },
      paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font: {
        color: bodyColor
      },
      showlegend: false,
      hovermode: "closest",
      autosize: true
    };

    ObservatoryCharts.react(
      volumeChart,
      [trace],
      layout,
      {
        responsive: true,
        displaylogo: false,
        scrollZoom: false
      }
    );

    const totalVolume = daily.reduce(
      (sum, row) => sum + row.Volume,
      0
    );

    volumeStatus.textContent =
      `Trading date: ${date} · ` +
      `${daily.length} expirations · ` +
      `total Call + Put volume: ` +
      `${totalVolume.toLocaleString()}`;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // Load VIX history + option-volume history
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  Promise.all([
    fetch(
      `${rawData}/vix_term_structure_history.csv`
    )
      .then(response => {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("VIX history unavailable");
        }

        return response.text();
      }),

    fetch(
      `${rawData}/option_volume_history.csv`
    )
      .then(response => {
        // Volume history is optional. If it is unavailable,
        // keep the VIX term-structure chart working.
        if (!response.ok) {
          return "";
        }

        return response.text();
      })
      .catch(error => {
        console.warn(
          "Option-volume history unavailable:",
          error
        );

        return "";
      }),
    plotlyReady
  ])
    .then(([
      vixText,
      volumeText
    ]) => {
      const rows =
        parseCsv(vixText);

      const volumeRows =
        parseVolumeCsv(volumeText);

      const allDates = [
        ...new Set(
          rows.map(row => row.Date)
        )
      ].sort();

      if (!allDates.length) {
        throw new Error("No VIX history rows");
      }

      const latestDate =
        allDates[allDates.length - 1];

      const cutoff =
        isoDate(latestDate);

      cutoff.setUTCDate(
        cutoff.getUTCDate() - 29
      );

      const recentDates =
        allDates.filter(
          date => isoDate(date) >= cutoff
        );

      if (!recentDates.length) {
        throw new Error("No recent VIX dates");
      }

      slider.min = "0";
      slider.max = String(recentDates.length - 1);
      slider.step = "1";
      slider.value = String(recentDates.length - 1);
      slider.disabled = false;

      startLabel.textContent =
        recentDates[0];

      endLabel.textContent =
        recentDates[recentDates.length - 1];

      function updateFromSlider() {
        const selectedDate =
          recentDates[Number(slider.value)];

        renderTermStructure(
          rows,
          selectedDate
        );

        renderVolume(
          volumeRows,
          selectedDate
        );
      }

      slider.addEventListener(
        "input",
        updateFromSlider
      );

      updateFromSlider();
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error(
        "VIX interactive chart error:",
        error
      );

      status.textContent =
        "Interactive history could not be loaded; " +
        "showing the latest static chart instead.";

      chart.innerHTML = `
        <img
          src="${rawOutput}/latest_term_structure.png"
          alt="Latest TXO VIX term structure"
          style="width:100%; max-width:960px;"
        >
      `;

      volumeStatus.textContent =
        "Option-volume history could not be loaded.";

      slider.disabled = true;
    });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // Front-expiry VIX vs TAIEX
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  const frontChart =
    document.getElementById("front-vix-taiex-chart");

  const frontStatus =
    document.getElementById("front-vix-taiex-status");

  Promise.all([
    fetch(
      `${rawOutput}/latest_front_vix_vs_taiex.json`
    )
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          "Front-expiry VIX / TAIEX data unavailable"
        );
      }

      return response.json();
    }),
    plotlyReady
  ])
    .then(([payload]) => {
      const rows = payload.data;

      if (!rows || !rows.length) {
        throw new Error("No observations");
      }

      const dates =
        rows.map(row => row.Date);

      const taiex =
        rows.map(row => Number(row.TAIEX_Close));

      const vix =
        rows.map(row => Number(row.Front_VIX));

      const contracts =
        rows.map(row => row.Contract);

      const taiexTrace = {
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "lines+markers",
        x: dates,
        y: taiex,
        xaxis: "x",
        yaxis: "y",
        name: "TAIEX Close",
        marker: {
          size: 6
        },
        line: {
          width: 2
        },
        hovertemplate:
          "<b>%{x}</b>" +
          "<br>TAIEX Close: %{y:,.2f}" +
          "<extra></extra>"
      };

      const vixTrace = {
        type: "scatter",
        mode: "lines+markers",
        x: dates,
        y: vix,
        xaxis: "x2",
        yaxis: "y2",
        name: "Front-expiry VIX",
        customdata: contracts,
        marker: {
          size: 6
        },
        line: {
          width: 2
        },
        hovertemplate:
          "<b>%{x}</b>" +
          "<br>Contract: %{customdata}" +
          "<br>VIX: %{y:.2f}%" +
          "<extra></extra>"
      };

      const frontBodyColor =
        getComputedStyle(document.body).color;

      const frontLayout = {
        title: {
          text: "TAIEX vs Front-expiry VIX",
          x: 0.5,
          font: {
            size: 19
          }
        },
        xaxis: {
          domain: [0, 1],
          anchor: "y",
          type: "date",
          showticklabels: false,
          showgrid: false
        },
        yaxis: {
          domain: [0.57, 1],
          title: "TAIEX Close",
          gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.18)",
          automargin: true
        },
        xaxis2: {
          domain: [0, 1],
          anchor: "y2",
          matches: "x",
          type: "date",
          title: {
            text: "Trading Date",
            standoff: 10
          },
          tickformat: "%m-%d",
          showgrid: false,
          automargin: true
        },
        yaxis2: {
          domain: [0, 0.42],
          title: "VIX (%)",
          gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,0.18)",
          automargin: true
        },
        margin: {
          l: 75,
          r: 35,
          t: 65,
          b: 65
        },
        paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        font: {
          color: frontBodyColor
        },
        showlegend: false,
        hovermode: "closest",
        autosize: true
      };

      ObservatoryCharts.react(
        frontChart,
        [
          taiexTrace,
          vixTrace
        ],
        frontLayout,
        {
          responsive: true,
          displaylogo: false,
          scrollZoom: false
        }
      );

      frontStatus.textContent =
        `Latest observation: ${payload.as_of_date} · ` +
        `move the cursor over the lines to inspect values.`;
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error(error);

      frontStatus.textContent =
        "TAIEX / front-expiry VIX history could not be loaded.";
    });

  // ------------------------------------------------------------
  // TX / MXF IV charts
  // ------------------------------------------------------------

  const ivPlots = [];

  async function renderIvProduct(payload, product, prefix) {
    const container = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chart`);
    const chartStatus = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-status`);
    const reset = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-iv-reset`);
    const data = payload.products[product];
    if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.curves)) throw new Error("IV curve data unavailable");
    container.replaceChildren();
    const plots = [];
    for (const curve of data.curves) {
      const panel = document.createElement("section");
      panel.className = "txo-iv-panel";
      const title = document.createElement("h4");
      title.textContent = `TXO ${curve.option_contract} → ${product} ${curve.futures_contract}`;
      const details = document.createElement("p");
      details.className = "txo-iv-details";
      details.textContent = `Expiry ${curve.expiry} · DTE ${curve.days_to_expiry} · ` +
        `${curve.puts.length + curve.calls.length} points · F = ${curve.forward.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 2})}`;
      panel.append(title, details);
      container.append(panel);
      if (!curve.puts.length && !curve.calls.length) {
        const empty = document.createElement("p");
        empty.textContent = "No eligible OTM quotes for this expiration.";
        panel.append(empty);
        continue;
      }
      const plot = document.createElement("div");
      plot.className = "txo-iv-plot";
      plot.setAttribute("role", "img");
      plot.setAttribute("aria-label", `OTM implied volatility by strike for TXO ${curve.option_contract}, using ${product} ${curve.futures_contract}`);
      panel.append(plot);
      const traces = [["puts", "OTM Put", "#297fb8", "circle"], ["calls", "OTM Call", "#d78328", "square"]]
        .filter(([key]) => curve[key].length)
        .map(([key, name, color, symbol]) => ({
          type: "scatter", mode: "markers", name,
          x: curve[key].map(point => point[0]), y: curve[key].map(point => point[1]),
          customdata: curve[key].map(point => point[2]),
          marker: { color, symbol, size: 5, opacity: .85 },
          hovertemplate: `TXO ${curve.option_contract} · ${payload.as_of_date}` +
            "<br>Strike: %{x:,.0f}<br>IV: %{y:.2f}%" +
            "<br>Option price: %{customdata:,.2f} points<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>"
        }));
      await ObservatoryCharts.newPlot(plot, traces, {
        margin: { l: 58, r: 12, t: 12, b: 85 },
        xaxis: { title: {text: "Strike price"}, tickformat: ",.0f", nticks: 4,
          gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,.18)", automargin: true },
        yaxis: { title: {text: "Implied volatility (%)"}, gridcolor: "rgba(127,127,127,.18)", automargin: true },
        shapes: [{ type: "line", xref: "x", yref: "paper", x0: curve.forward, x1: curve.forward,
          y0: 0, y1: 1, line: { color: "#888", width: 1.5, dash: "dash" } }],
        paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        font: { color: getComputedStyle(document.body).color, size: 11 },
        legend: { orientation: "h", x: 0, y: -.3 },
        hovermode: "closest", dragmode: "zoom", autosize: true
      }, { responsive: true, displayModeBar: false, scrollZoom: false });
      plots.push(plot);
      ivPlots.push(plot);
    }
    if (!data.curves.length) {
      container.textContent = `No option expiration has an exact same-expiry ${product} futures match.`;
    }
    reset.disabled = !plots.length;
    reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
      plots.forEach(plot => Plotly.relayout(plot, {"xaxis.autorange": true, "yaxis.autorange": true}));
    });
    chartStatus.textContent = `Latest trading date: ${payload.as_of_date} · ` +
      `${data.plotted_points} OTM IV points · Generated in Taiwan: ${payload.generated_at_taipei}`;
    container.setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
  }

  Promise.all([
    fetch(`${rawOutput}/latest_iv.json`, {cache: "no-cache"}).then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("IV data unavailable");
      return response.json();
    }),
    plotlyReady
  ]).then(async ([payload]) => {
    if (payload.schema !== 1 || JSON.stringify(payload.point_columns) !== JSON.stringify(["strike", "iv_pct", "option_price"])) {
      throw new Error("Unsupported IV chart data");
    }
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([renderIvProduct(payload, "TX", "tx"), renderIvProduct(payload, "MTX", "mtx")]);
    const failed = results.find(result => result.status === "rejected");
    if (failed) throw failed.reason;
  }).catch(error => {
    console.error("IV chart error:", error);
    ivPlots.forEach(plot => Plotly.purge(plot));
    for (const prefix of ["tx", "mtx"]) {
      const container = document.getElementById(`${prefix}-chart`);
      container.replaceChildren();
      container.setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
      document.getElementById(`${prefix}-iv-reset`).disabled = true;
      document.getElementById(`${prefix}-status`).textContent = "IV chart data could not be loaded. Please try again later.";
    }
  });


})();
</script>
```

For detailed contract specifications and expiration dates, please refer to the [TAIFEX Futures Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tX) and [TAIFEX Options Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tXO).
